scope: Public existing molecular data; no new human study and no drug-efficacy research

notes: Previously explored; cannot be unseen validation
14 regional samples, 8 donors in existing analysis
Material corrected from brain to spinal cord after official GEO metadata audit on 2026-09-15
Age strata are not within-animal longitudinal visits
Design and sample mappings must be verified before inference
Pre-filtered counts; shared animals across regions may occur
Not independent of related brain study until verified
Do not pool blood and brain estimands
FPKM is not a count-model input; expression analysis disabled
Mixed SCA2/SCA3 and controls; clone is not donor
Disease versus corrected line; not healthy case-control replication
Cultures do not count as independent patients
Held expression data; independence and comparable estimand not established
Not a confirmed external validation cohort
